scope: Owner-gated native dispatch now prepares one canonical Execution, spawns a real herdr pane child, confirms the OS pid/start marker and LaunchSpec, and records the real process exit. NOT member-initiated ingress, cross-backend takeover, default entry, packaging or human UI.
existing_capability_and_gap: Reuse Viva prepare_member_dispatch/confirm_launch/LaunchSpec/record_exit/record_result, the native owner-frontend capability, and herdr's real PTY/workspace. The gap was that no new-base path connected a canonical execution to a real pane process or its exit.
behavior: viva.execution.start is admitted only for a host-bound owner frontend on the actual socket peer. prepare_execution checks the persisted pause gate and canonical task/member/live-grant/principal/worktree/idempotency rules, then records the intent before any process exists. The runtime creates a pane whose root argv is the execution command (no shell interpolation), records the real child PID and OS start marker, inserts LaunchSpec and confirms the intent. Pane death reports the child exit code when the OS provides one; signal/unknown exits are recorded with the old -1 sentinel and exit_code_known=false. A process exit never completes a task. Spawn or confirmation failure closes the pane child and marks the intent unresolved.

qa_report: .qa-tmp/pr198-independent-qa-report.md (independent QA, not part of the product tree)

qa_fixes.F1: Deliberate pane/tab/workspace close now resolves the public pane identity and calls execution_pane_exited(..., None) before the pane/workspace state is removed and the runtime is shut down. New tests: herdr close_workspace_reports_execution_panes_before_removal and Viva execution_exit_settles_and_releases_the_owned_binding (unknown exit -> stopped, binding/owned released, task not done, duplicate close is a no-op).
qa_fixes.F2: ExecutionPlan and viva.execution.start now carry intent_state. Fresh spawns report confirmed; replays report the recorded state (confirmed/exited/unresolved). Tests assert running replay = confirmed and post-exit replay = exited with the historical pid.
qa_fixes.F3: source-hashes.json regenerated after the final evidence content and excludes itself (a self-hash cannot be stable).
qa_fixes.F4: execution_failed keeps the execution in the host-owned set while its intent is unresolved, so a fast-exit/spawn-failure race cannot make owner_only_phase_locked reject every later native start. New deterministic test spawn_failure_does_not_poison_the_owner_gate.
qa_fixes.F5: PaneDied(Handoff) no longer calls execution_exited: a live PTY moved to another host is not a process exit. Currently unreachable in the embedded preview, but the guard is in place.
